mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary easing becomes embedded in market expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE crosses above 4.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) predicts S&P 500 returns: when RSAFS growth is negative and HOUST growth is below 1% YoY, it signals a housing market collapse triggering negative equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth is negative and HOUST growth < 1% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production below 100, supply shocks from reduced manufacturing output lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a stronger labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining consumer spending (RSAFS growth below 0.5% YoY), demand shocks lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth < 0.5% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between industrial production (INDPRO) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) predicts S&P 500 returns: when INDPRO growth is negative and FEDFUNDS is rising, it signals stagflationary conditions triggering negative equity returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth is negative and FEDFUNDS is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 2-year windows.
